name: Minagi Mio
source:
Mio has been a hikikomori since the latter half of middle school.

Her hobby is playing the role of guild princess in MMOs and other online games, manipulating the old guys there and causing them to go to ruin. Out of a weakness in her heart, she maintains self-esteem by gathering followers through live-streaming on the internet. These actions are driven by her inferiority complex and hatred towards her older sister, who seems to do everything with ease, combined with the tumult of emotions that comes with puberty. She doesn't really understand it herself, however.

She seems dominant, but also has a submissive side. She craves to be scolded.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/048/index.html]official website[/url]]
